# Custom U-Boot environment for a fast, quiet boot with a GPIO "alive" LED.
# Place on the FAT boot partition (RPi / BeagleBone read uEnv.txt automatically),
# or import from U-Boot:  fatload mmc 0:1 $loadaddr uEnv.txt; env import -t $loadaddr $filesize

# --- kernel command line -------------------------------------------------
# quiet + no console blank + fast rootwait; tune root= for your media
console=ttyS0,115200
extra_bootargs=quiet loglevel=3 consoleblank=0 rootwait ro fsck.repair=yes
bootargs=console=${console} root=/dev/mmcblk0p2 ${extra_bootargs}

# --- fast path: skip network, skip long delays -----------------------
bootdelay=0
bootcmd=run diagcmd; run mmcboot

diagcmd=diag led on; diag info

mmcboot=fatload mmc 0:1 ${kernel_addr_r} Image; \
        fatload mmc 0:1 ${fdt_addr_r} board.dtb; \
        booti ${kernel_addr_r} - ${fdt_addr_r}

# turn the LED off just before handing control to the kernel
preboot=diag led blink 2
